basis: Supplied and installed, excl. VAT. Consumer prices from Finnish retailers converted at 25.5 % VAT. Taloon category medians use regular (non-campaign) prices of the first listing page, checked 14 Nov 2026. Excludes design, demolition, permits, waterproofing of wet rooms and travel charges.

researched.label: Finnish retail prices, Nov 2026
researched.detail: Each unit price is built from published Finnish prices: product and category prices and fixed installation prices on Taloon.com, the K-Rauta window guide, and published hourly rates for the hours we assume. Hover a price, or see the per-item list below, for the exact link and figure.
